purpose: Set or confirm the target SpaceClaim window's maximized state while recording any necessary layout exception.
trigger: Use after a unique target session is confirmed and before active visual or script control.

inputs.name: target_window
inputs.description: Stable target window identity and observed current state.

inputs.name: layout_exception
inputs.description: Declared reason and bounds for an exception that prevents maximization.

preconditions: The target window is unique and can receive one layout action.
Any exception is declared by the task owner.

outputs.name: window_state
outputs.description: Observed final maximized state, bounds, and window identity.

outputs.name: exception_record
outputs.description: Empty when maximized; otherwise explicit exception reason and affected interaction.

postconditions: The target window is maximized, or an explicit necessary exception is recorded.
No document, selection, geometry, or script state changes.

implementation.target_environment: Authorized SpaceClaim V21 desktop session with the target window kept maximized unless a recorded layout exception applies.
implementation.notes: The controller performs one bounded GUI action or observation; it must not expand this contract into a workflow. Desktop-state action only; it does not hide dialogs or change model data.

ambiguity_checks: Use only the declared identity, state, or geometry predicates; do not substitute recorded FaceN/BodyN aliases or an arbitrary collection member.
If the declared evidence cannot make the target unique, return needs_manual_review and do not continue.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Not applicable; the operation does not mutate model topology.

failure_modes.condition: The target window cannot be uniquely identified.
The requested state change cannot be confirmed.
failure_modes.detection: Post-action observation disagrees or the manager rejects it.

recovery.action: Return to EX-02 and refresh the session inventory.
Record needs_manual_review and do not claim maximized state.

validation.method: Validate this object against operation-template.schema.json and compare operation_id with the EX/ER catalog slug.
validation.expected: The object is schema-valid, remains candidate, and declares exactly one bounded execution_recovery action.

validation.method: Read the linked single-operation guidance and compare its input, result, procedure, and rejection fields with this contract.
validation.expected: The contract exposes every declared input/output and preserves refusal, recovery, and needs_manual_review behavior.

validation.method: Use the operation-specific controller or host-tool adapter only after the required authorization and target-state gates are independently satisfied.
validation.expected: The target window is maximized, or an explicit necessary exception is recorded.

evidence_level.notes: Guidance interface checked on host; synthetic independent application reviewed. No controller event or repaired geometry was observed for this guide.
